instruction.text: Elizabeth lived a life of wealth and luxury. Drag the words to correctly label her outfit.

feedback.end: Elizabeth’s fashion showed off her wealth. She wore lots of jewellery, white makeup and fine clothing. In Tudor times, only really rich people could wear colours like gold, purple and red!

instruction.text: Would this person be able to wear gold, purple and red?

hint.text: Remember, only really rich people could wear gold, purple or red.

end.text: Although Queen Elizabeth I’s reign is known as the Golden Age, life was still very difficult if you were poor.
end.sound: Although Queen Elizabuth the first’s reign is known as the Golden Age, life was still very difficult if you were poor.

atoms.b: During Queen Elizabeth I’s reign, the population of England got ((++bigger sillier)). This meant there were more poor people.
atoms.sound: During Queen Elizabuth the first’s reign, the population of England got bigger. This meant there were more poor people.

atoms.b: There was a belief that being poor was your own fault, so there was ((++little lots_of)) support.
However, near the end of her reign, Elizabeth introduced the ((++Poor Pool)) Law.
atoms.sound: However, near the end of her reign, Elizabuth introduced the Poor Law.

instruction.text: Listen and select the correct end to the sentence.

atoms.a: When the Poor Law was introduced, ...

b.sound: everyone had to pay money to the government to help the poor.
poor people had to pay millions of pounds to the government.

atoms.a: The Poor Law banned begging and set up special houses ...

b.sound: so that poor people had somewhere to stay.
so that really rich people could live in them.

atoms.a: The Poor Law was the first time that the government ...

b.sound: was responsible for helping the poor.
